title: One more to Go
description: Stunned by the aftermath of Boba Fett's unbelievably efficient assault on the Kintan Striders Gang, Fixer and Camie looked around the power station, mouths agape, stunned by what they have just witnessed. Fett walked to the bar and downed the entirety of a drink before he walked out the same way he came, all without saying a single word. Completing step one of his repulsor train-stopping plan, Boba Fett stole all of the speeder bikes belonging to the Kintan Striders Gang.
